Natural Earth 1:110m land outlines (public domain).
Authors: Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and Natural Earth contributors.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Retrieved: 2026-10-09
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

mercator_land.inl is derived from ne_110m_land.geojson with
tools/generate_world_map.py. The application embeds this offline map;
no network service or map tiles are used at runtime.
